Accumulator of taxed (reflected) tokens.

Team fee numerator, set to 4 in _transfer before tax computation.
payable fee recipient; also the privileged auth check inside manualswap and manualsend.
payable fee recipient (second third of the ETH balance).
payable fee recipient (third third of the ETH balance).

Core internal transfer logic: blacklist check, tax setup, max-tx check and automatic fee swap before token movement.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the router and sends it to the contract.
Splits accumulated ETH into three equal parts and pushes them to the fee wallets.
Owner-only bootstrap: sets router, creates pair, adds liquidity and enables swapping.
Privileged manual trigger of swapTokensForEth by _feeAddrWallet1.
Privileged manual trigger of sendETHToFee using the whole contract ETH balance.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldown/max transaction check.
Owner-only reset of _maxTxAmount back to the full total supply.
Owner-only renunciation of ownership, setting _owner to the zero address.
Applies reflective balance updates, team fee and reflection fee for a transfer.
Mints the team share of reflections to the contract address.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal by the reflection fee.
Empty payable fallback that accepts ETH sent to the contract.
Returns the token balance of an account by converting reflections via tokenFromReflection.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks and Approval event.
Converts a reflection amount to a token amount using the current rate.

Native ETH .transfer() calls to _feeAddrWallet1/2/3 executed right after the external swap returns.

Reflective balances and fee accounting are written after the external swap in the same _transfer flow, creating a reentrancy window.

edges.reason: transfer reads _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
transfer delegates execution to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to internal _transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance spending.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the remaining allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer forwards to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer performs the external fee swap before balances are updated.
_transfer compares from against uniswapV2Pair to detect a buy.
_transfer enforces require(!bots[from]) gating who may transfer.
_transfer branches on cooldownEnabled for the max transaction check.
_transfer requires amount <= _maxTxAmount on cooldown buys.
_transfer branches on swapEnabled before swapping tokens for ETH.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before performing the swap.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee for the recipient.
_transfer sets the tax numerator _feeAddr1 used in fee arithmetic.
_transfer sets the team tax numerator _feeAddr2 used in fee arithmetic.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the swap and approval.
swapTokensForEth triggers the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
sendETHToFee executes native ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
sendETHToFee transfers amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet2.
sendETHToFee transfers amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet3.
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call with the contract balance.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
openTrading stores and uses the router instance.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading performs the external approve on the pair token.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before sending ETH.
setCooldownEnabled is onlyOwner and therefore reads _owner.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
liftMaxTx sets _maxTxAmount back to the total supply.
liftMaxTx is onlyOwner and therefore reads _owner.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and overwrites _owner with address(0).
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee after moving balances.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate the team share.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds the team reflections to _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee reduces the _rTotal reflections supply.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal with the taxed amount.
balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads the caller reflection balance from _rOwned.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal and uses the rate.
the external approve is performed on the IERC20 at uniswapV2Pair.
reflection balances are only mutated after the external swap returns, leaving a reentrancy window.
_transferStandard uses _getValues to derive r- and t-values.
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token-value split.
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection-value split.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current exchange rate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getRate divides the reflection supply from _rTotal.
_getRate divides by the token supply _tTotal.
_getValues passes _feeAddr1 as the reflection tax numerator.
_getValues passes _feeAddr2 as the team tax numerator.
from parameter flows into _transfer as the debit account.
to parameter flows into _transfer as the credit account.
amount parameter flows into _transfer and is compared to _maxTxAmount.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into approve.
spender parameter flows into approve.
account parameter flows into balanceOf.
tokenAmount parameter flows into swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter flows into sendETHToFee and is divided by three.
tAmount parameter flows into _transferStandard as the raw amount.
local contractTokenBalance holds balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
local contractETHBalance holds address(this).balance inside _transfer.
local currentRate holds the rate used in _takeTeam.
